**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The licence grant in § 13 satisfies the playbook's preferred position:

- **§ 13.1** — subscription grant runs to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," worldwide, with no written-notice precondition (better than the fallback), plus Authorized User rights.
- **§ 13.2** — paid-up/embedded Vendor Technology is licensed on a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid" basis to Customer and its Affiliates, including contractor support and modification/derivative rights.
- **§ 13.3** — transfer permitted to an Affiliate or successor via § 24 (which lets us assign to an M&A successor without Vendor consent), and Vendor may revoke or suspend only for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure period — no at-will revocability.
- **§ 13.4** restrictions are standard and carve out legally protected activity, authorized security testing, and use of Customer Data/output.
